claim_support.claim: LADDER publishes a relevant-sentence binary task, with positives defined by annotated attack patterns and sampled remaining sentences as negatives.
claim_support.evidence: Section 3.4.1, Relevant Sentence Extraction; read the original author paper.

claim_support.claim: AnnoCTR annotates explicit and implicit cybersecurity concepts and links mentions to ATT&CK.
claim_support.evidence: Corpus construction and task definitions; released ce_tags and ci_tags independently inspected.

claim_support.claim: MalwareTextDB provides malware action, entity and modifier sequence-labeling targets.
claim_support.evidence: Sections 3 and 5.2; native token files already contain BIO Entity/Action/Modifier labels.

claim_support.claim: CASIE extracts cybersecurity event nuggets and arguments with five native event types.
claim_support.evidence: Annotation schema, corpus statistics and experiments; original JSON sample inspected.

claim_support.claim: The Security-TTP-Mapping Expert subset is paragraph-to-ATT&CK matching, with candidate-assisted test annotation.
claim_support.evidence: Dataset collection and annotation appendix; all released Expert TSV splits parsed.

claim_support.claim: Text2TTP studies semantic ranking for adversarial technique annotation rather than a no-ATT&CK text rejection task.
claim_support.evidence: Dataset and ranking/evaluation sections; compared paper collection with current loader files.

claim_support.claim: CTI-ATE evaluates extraction of parent ATT&CK technique sets from 60 malware descriptions.
claim_support.evidence: Sections 3.4 and 4.1; native TSV GT column verified.

claim_support.claim: SecureNLP Subtask 1 classifies relevant and irrelevant malware-behavior sentences, with 9424/1213/618 sentence splits.
claim_support.evidence: Sections 2.1.7, 2.2 and Tables 1-2; original organizer paper read.

claim_support.claim: CySecED is a cybersecurity event-trigger detection task with 30 event types, not an ATT&CK applicability binary benchmark.
claim_support.evidence: Event ontology and dataset statistics in original paper; public full-data availability unverified.

claim_support.claim: CTI-HAL publishes human annotations of ATT&CK techniques in report contexts; null technique records can carry tool annotations.
claim_support.evidence: Original paper and official annotation JSON, including a MiniDuke tool record, inspected.

claim_support.claim: TIM uses three-sentence contexts and six TTP categories; a usable complete author data release was not verified.
claim_support.evidence: Original publisher article and its linked repository inspected.

claim_support.claim: TTPXHunter is technique classification with augmented examples; its released CSV has 193 classes and no native benign class.
claim_support.evidence: Original author preprint and released Dataset/MITRE_ATT&CK_Dataset.csv inspected.

claim_support.claim: This preprint describes a sentence-level technique classification corpus; an author download was not verified in the search.
claim_support.evidence: Dataset section and artifact links inspected; excluded from recommendations.
